meta.process_model: one fresh python process per item

bridge_phase1_dressings.name: bridge_phase1_dressings
bridge_phase1_dressings.call: lih_marriage_phase1.main(['--configs','C0,C1','--skip-mc','--no-scratch','--no-cache','--workers','12']) with lih_marriage_phase1.OUT / .CACHE redirected to a temp dir
bridge_phase1_dressings.notes: regenerates the Phase-1 dressings (direct 3-D quadrature R1/RC + production gVee.dress) from scratch and compares with the frozen debug/data/lih_marriage_phase1.npz (MC skipped)

bridge_reductions.name: bridge_reductions
bridge_reductions.call: tests/test_lih_r12ci_bridge.py helpers on debug/data/lih_marriage_phase1.npz: _reduce(D)=grid_int(D*neumann_potential(D,34,exact=True)); isotropic-shortcut + L<=2 fire-test values
bridge_reductions.notes: the bridge guard's recomputed quantities (exact-Neumann bridge on the frozen dressings)

fourbody_sigma_reduced.name: fourbody_sigma_reduced
fourbody_sigma_reduced.call: lih_r12_4body_integral.reduced(); control_norm_rhoB(); control_neumann_selfcoulomb() [module builds its 260x100 grid at import]
fourbody_sigma_reduced.notes: the two-centre sigma 4-body bridge gate (closed-form 5 alpha/8 anchor); geovac/lih_r12ci/fourbody.py is a verbatim copy of this module

gvee_sparse_vs_dense_5e-2.name: gvee_sparse_vs_dense_5e-2
gvee_sparse_vs_dense_5e-2.call: tests/test_lih_gvee_sparse.py fixture: KG.USE_EXACT_NEUMANN=True; pi ref trunc 5e-2; GeminalM('linexp'); reset_rng(); lih_pi_m16.hg_Vee_m(gem,refm,Fbar,force_general=True); reset_rng(); lih_gvee_sparse.hg_Vee_sparse(gem,refm,Fbar,mem_cap_gb=2.0|0.02); _DROP_NESTED fire test
gvee_sparse_vs_dense_5e-2.notes: (h_Vee,g_Vee,Vee,FVee,F2Vee) dense vs sparse; equal to roundoff only with identical RNG streams

marriage_2mo_generalized.name: marriage_2mo_generalized
marriage_2mo_generalized.call: KG.USE_EXACT_NEUMANN=True; lih_marriage_phase2.build_ref_2mo(); for g in (linexp,exp): P2.all_pieces(P2.Geminal(g),ref2,T0,verbose=False); P2.assemble(p,-7.887822) and P2.assemble(p,p['E0_grid'])
marriage_2mo_generalized.notes: Phase-2 gate G1 / Phase-3 M1a: the 2-MO reference through the generalized enumerators (frozen exact-path -7.917198 linexp / -7.943536 exp). Import of lih_marriage_phase2 ~2 min (gVee builds its phi kernels at import)

marriage_phase0_prims_scratch.name: marriage_phase0_prims_scratch
marriage_phase0_prims_scratch.notes: from-scratch sigma M=12 primitive S/h1/T1/ERI vs the committed cache

marriage_phase0_sigma_ref.name: marriage_phase0_sigma_ref
marriage_phase0_sigma_ref.call: lih_marriage_phase0.main(exact=True) with OUT/OUT_EXACT redirected to a temp dir [uses the committed prim cache debug/data/lih_marriage_phase0_prim.npz]
marriage_phase0_sigma_ref.notes: 74-det sigma reference: E_full -8.023354, E_trunc -8.022918, pair tensor T, NO grid densities. Compared array-by-array with the committed debug/data/lih_marriage_phase0_ref_exact.npz. SIDE EFFECT: grid_setup() sets geovac.lih_r12ci.kernels.USE_EXACT_NEUMANN

marriage_sigma74_exp.name: marriage_sigma74_exp
marriage_sigma74_exp.notes: the 74-det sigma marriage E_R12 (banked -8.037088, Paper 19). The banked value came from a process that ran M1a (2-MO) first; the triangle's randomized eigh draws from geovac.lih_r12ci.triangle.rng, so a different call order moves the result at the ~1e-7 level

marriage_sigma74_linexp.name: marriage_sigma74_linexp
marriage_sigma74_linexp.notes: the 74-det sigma marriage E_R12 (banked -8.037236, Paper 19). The banked value came from a process that ran M1a (2-MO) first; the triangle's randomized eigh draws from geovac.lih_r12ci.triangle.rng, so a different call order moves the result at the ~1e-7 level

marriage_sigma74_vmc_short.name: marriage_sigma74_vmc_short
marriage_sigma74_vmc_short.call: lih_marriage_phase3.build_truncated_wf(); lih_vmc.vmc_linear(wf,LinearGeminalJastrow(g,0.5,c,Fbar,2,2),nwalk=200,nsweep=200,nburn=50,seed=10) with c,Fbar from debug/data/lih_marriage_phase3.npz (m1_*); plus c=0 gate-6
marriage_sigma74_vmc_short.notes: G2 machinery on the 74-det reference at short, exactly reproducible statistics

neumann_exact.name: neumann_exact
neumann_exact.call: tests/test_lih_r12ci_neumann_exact.py helpers: _self_coulomb(zeta,RA,exact) for zeta in (4.5,2.6875); (aa|bb) dressings; m=1 coul_mode_potential exact/legacy vs solid-harmonic closed form

pafci_azimuthal_kernels.name: pafci_azimuthal_kernels
pafci_azimuthal_kernels.notes: test_prolate_allelectron_fci fast tests (mu=0 regression + toroidal kernel vs dphi quadrature)

pi_marriage_exp1.5_1e-2.name: pi_marriage_exp1.5_1e-2
pi_marriage_exp1.5_1e-2.call: lih_exp_geminal_run.install_kernels(1.5,None) [kernels.py GAM source-override, before imports]; KG.USE_EXACT_NEUMANN=True; ref=lih_pi_m16.build_primitives(CFG,PRIM_CACHE_PI); refm,info=build_ref_from_prims(ref,tag,cfg_tag='pi',trunc=1e-2); p=lih_gvee_sparse.all_pieces_sparse(lih_pi_m16.GeminalM('exp'),refm,T0,mem_cap_gb=6.0); lih_pi_m16.assemble_c(p,p['E0_grid'])
pi_marriage_exp1.5_1e-2.notes: Slater e^{-1.5 r} on the 9-det pi ref: Paper 19 Table tab:geminal_gamma -8.048141

pi_marriage_exp1.5_1e-3.name: pi_marriage_exp1.5_1e-3
pi_marriage_exp1.5_1e-3.call: lih_exp_geminal_run.install_kernels(1.5,None) [kernels.py GAM source-override, before imports]; KG.USE_EXACT_NEUMANN=True; ref=lih_pi_m16.build_primitives(CFG,PRIM_CACHE_PI); refm,info=build_ref_from_prims(ref,tag,cfg_tag='pi',trunc=1e-3); p=lih_gvee_sparse.all_pieces_sparse(lih_pi_m16.GeminalM('exp'),refm,T0,mem_cap_gb=6.0); lih_pi_m16.assemble_c(p,p['E0_grid'])
pi_marriage_exp1.5_1e-3.notes: THE corpus-best LiH energy -8.04905 (Paper 19; -8.049045089 post-fix). ~15 GB peak, ~3 h

pi_marriage_linexp_1e-2.name: pi_marriage_linexp_1e-2
pi_marriage_linexp_1e-2.notes: linexp r e^{-0.5 r} on the 9-det pi ref. Banked pre-wcomb-fix -8.042181 (Sep 23, dense); post-fix Paper 19 table -8.042304

pi_marriage_linexp_1e-3.name: pi_marriage_linexp_1e-3
pi_marriage_linexp_1e-3.notes: linexp on the full pi ref: banked -8.043494 (Sep 25, PRE triangle-weight fix). ~9 GB peak, ~2.5 h

pi_prims_scratch.name: pi_prims_scratch
pi_prims_scratch.call: lih_pi_m16.build_primitives(lih_pi_m16.CFG, <temp path>) [from scratch: one_body_general + prolate_float_eri.build_eri_tensor_m_f] vs debug/data/lih_pi_m16_prim.npz; then lih_pi_m16.fci_solve(h1_f,eri_f,Mk) vs debug/data/lih_pi_m16_fci_pi_canon.npz
pi_prims_scratch.notes: from-scratch M=16 pi primitives + 14400-det FCI (eigsh tol=0, sign fixed by max-|c| > 0)

pi_ref_truncations.name: pi_ref_truncations
pi_ref_truncations.call: lih_pi_m16.build_primitives(CFG,PRIM_CACHE_PI) [cached debug/data/lih_pi_m16_prim.npz]; build_ref_from_prims(ref,tag,cfg_tag='pi',trunc=t) for t in (5e-2,1e-2,5e-3,1e-3) [cached FCI vectors debug/data/lih_pi_m16_fci_pi_{canon,no}.npz]
pi_ref_truncations.notes: the pi reference at each truncation: E_full -8.02905, E_trunc (-8.025184 @1e-2, -8.028633 @1e-3), nact, the m-resolved tensor T. SIDE EFFECT: sets KG.USE_EXACT_NEUMANN=True (via P0.grid_setup)

routec_fci_fast_vs_dense_random.name: routec_fci_fast_vs_dense_random
routec_fci_fast_vs_dense_random.call: rng=np.random.default_rng(1); random symmetric h1 (8x8), chemist eri*0.1 (8^4); prolate_allelectron_fci.fci_energy(h1,e,8,4) vs fci_fast.fci_energy_fast(h1,e,8,4)

tri_symmetry_5e-2.name: tri_symmetry_5e-2

vmc_orbitals.name: vmc_orbitals
vmc_orbitals.call: lih_vmc.extract_prim(orb); lih_vmc.orbital_value_grad(prim,pts,R) [pts: default_rng(1)]; lih_vmc.orbital_vgl(prim,pts,R) [pts: default_rng(3)]; prolate_allelectron_c4._orb_on_grid(orb,_grid_template(R,N_grid=24,xi_max=10.0)) at the middle node
vmc_orbitals.notes: test_lih_vmc orbital gates; orbitals = Li1s_core, core2_4.5, H1s, bond21, pi_p00, pi_m10
